name: create_agent_function
description: Defines a function to create a function-calling agent that integrates with the RAG system.

name: create_agent_function_docstring
description: Docstring that describes the purpose of the create_agent function.
full_code: """Create a function-calling agent and add it to the graph."""

name: system_prompt_modification
description: Modifies the system prompt to include instructions for the agent's behavior.
full_code:
system_prompt += ("\nWork autonomously according to your specialty, using the tools available to you."
    " Do not ask for clarification."
    " Your other team members (and other teams) will collaborate with you with their own specialties."
    " You are chosen for a reason!")

name: prompt_creation
description: Creates a prompt using the ChatPromptTemplate from the modified system prompt and placeholders.

name: agent_creation
description: Creates an agent using the OpenAI functions agent with the provided LLM, tools, and prompt.

name: executor_creation
description: Creates an executor that manages the agent and its tools.

name: return_executor
description: Returns the created executor from the create_agent function.

name: MessagesPlaceholder_class
description: Placeholder class used in the prompt creation to represent message variables.
